Nigerian singer Cynthia Morgan has urged citizens to take the upcoming 2027 general elections seriously, warning that voters’ choices will directly affect their safety and future.
In a recent post shared on her Instagram page, the music star expressed strong views about the state of the nation and the importance of leadership choices.
“Whoever you vote for next year in the general elections is going to determine if you’re going to live long,” Morgan wrote.
She also called for accountability, stating her hope that individuals undermining the country’s peace and stability would face consequences.
